reason: The hexagonal cell (a approximately 3.8515 A, c approximately 21.8411 A), rhombohedral lattice, Z=3, Hg/Ni ordering, and average layered framework are strongly supported, and the submitted model is physically plausible. However, exact recovery is not sufficiently established: no comparable whole-pattern score was supplied; the trajectory optimized mainly a peak-height surrogate within R-3m; and its lower-symmetry trials either collapsed independent S sites or were dismissed without testing the physically plausible nearby polar solution. A read-only verifier fit finds a non-overlapping R3m distortion with sensible Hg-S distances (approximately 2.42 A) and Ni-S distances (approximately 2.46-2.62 A) that improves the same full-profile fit from about 7.03% to 6.69% Rwp (weighted residual sum lower by about 3.6%). Thus the data support the cell, Z, ordering, and average framework more strongly than the submitted centrosymmetric symmetry and exact coordinates, and another attempt should explicitly refine and compare the viable R3m alternative.
